captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a small-office all-in-one printer in a light gray and dark gray color scheme. It features a main rectangular base body with a hollow front cavity containing a pull-out paper cassette tray. On top is a flatbed scanner lid with an integrated automatic document feeder (ADF) unit, and a small black control panel is mounted on the front right corner. The scanner lid, feeder cover, and control panel are designed to rotate on respective hinges, while the cassette tray slides out and the panel buttons/dial act as functional inputs.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a small-office all-in-one printer. The assembly should include a main printer body with a hollow front bay, a sliding paper cassette tray, a hinged flatbed scanner lid on top, an integrated automatic document feeder with its own rotating cover, and a tilting front-right control panel complete with a rotary selector dial and individual push buttons.
captions.factory: The printer is built hierarchically using CadQuery. The base is constructed from a box with a front slot subtracted to form a hollow cavity. The paper cassette is a separate sliding block fitting inside this cavity. The flatbed lid is created as a flat box with a rear hinge pivot. On top of the lid, the document feeder is modeled with small support blocks and a rotating top cover. The control panel is constructed as a tilted box on a horizontal pivot, decorated with a small cylinder for the rotary dial and tiny rectangular prisms for the keypad buttons.
